name: BACH_0107
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (99%)** · Confident · Careful review
Tier 1 surgical frozen section with single-class set [F1], positive margins, and mixed neighbors.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Invasive 99%, InSitu 1% | Strong invasive score |
| Conformal set | Invasive (90% coverage) | Single-class 90% set |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability, 94% OOD [F6] | Passes QC; high OOD |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree (true) | Models match top class |
| Similar cases | 2/5 Invasive (40%), 3/5 InSitu [F5] | Mixed with InSitu |

## Tissue evidence
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (region 3) · context · Below-typical score pushing toward invasive [F2] (8/20 check) · Weak
- **Gland / tubule formation** (region 11) · ↑ invasive · Scarce tubules pushing toward invasive [F3] (18/20 check) · Weak
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 8) · ↑ invasive · Above-typical stromal invasion [F4] (19/20 check) · Validated
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (region 11) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score pushing away (20/20 check) · Validated
- **Sampled cell counts** (regions 1, 5) · context · 81% benign epithelium [F8] (wrong-direction), 0% immune [F7] · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful; top-3 risk deletion beats random deletion (95% CI 0.002–0.020).
- **Concepts**: Unproven (deletion CI -0.009–0.006 includes 0); mitoses (0/20), normal lobules (0/20), necrosis (3/20) are Unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- High-grade InSitu mimics invasion; 3/5 nearest cases are InSitu, including contrast case BACH_0155 (82% similarity).
- Frozen-section artifacts or benign-heavy sampling (insufficient tumor nuclei) inflate risk and all-margin calls [F9].

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 8, 4, 1**: Confirm stromal invasion in highest-risk heatmap regions (99%–100% risk).
2. **Regions 3, 9, 10, 11**: Check duct confinement and pleomorphism versus InSitu contrast BACH_0155.
3. **Regions 1, 5**: Verify sparse tumor nuclei (12 counted) and all four flagged margins.
